created_by: Dylan L.R. Pollock with Atlas continuity support
description: Master Plan v120.0 updates the v101.1 PyHuey cockpit alignment baseline into the current post-cleanup/post-HIMS-foundation state. It preserves the Lenovo Legion Go / Huey Brain V1 scope lock, records current LabTech and HueyTech roles, documents temporary-use devices, promotes src/huey/media as the canonical media domain, formalizes HIMS as an emerging append-only internal messaging foundation, and defines a conservative V1.5 augmented proof that adds HIMS shadow traces and dashboard/tooling visibility without reactivating live mic, wake word, Huey Body actuation, full governance, or distributed compute.

current_session_evidence: Generated-artifact cleanup merged into main via PR #743.
Salvaged local work was protected and later merged via PR #745, reducing the broad WIP surface to eight changed files before merge.
Legacy root compatibility wrappers were removed via PR #746, leaving canonical implementations under src/huey/memory/PY and src/huey/media.
Media-tool consolidation was opened as draft PR #747, centralizing audio analysis under huey.media while retaining huey.audio compatibility.
HIMS foundation was opened as draft PR #748 with src/huey/messaging, HIMSMessage, HIMSEvent, HIMSStore, tests, and architecture documentation.
Standalone L:/PyHuey was archived after inspection showed it was not a git checkout and not the active local app root.
Embedded src/huey/connectors/pyhuey currently imports as a connector/scaffold, not a full standalone desktop PyHuey GUI.

current_reality.summary: Huey Brain V1 remains a single-node deterministic proof on the Lenovo Legion Go. LabTech and temporary-use devices support development, ingress, review, and cockpit work. HIMS is now entering implementation as an append-only messaging foundation, but is not yet a controlling runtime. Huey Body remains paused for V1.
current_reality.active_proof_loop: known MP3 fixture -> FFmpeg/media preparation -> local transcription -> response bridge -> structured JSON/JSONL log
current_reality.current_phase: Huey Brain V1 with early V1.5 augmentation scaffolding
active_truths: Huey Brain is the V1 execution boundary.
Huey Body is real hardware, but paused for V1.
LabTech enters, prepares, observes, archives, and recovers; it does not become Huey.
HueyTech is the Huey-side hardware/software capability class; in V1 it is represented by Huey Brain and the HueyOS runtime package.
Temporary-use devices and cloud/editor tools may support work but do not become canonically sovereign components.
HIMS exists as doctrine and is now starting as local append-only package infrastructure, not as a full routing authority.
PyHuey is a cockpit/tooling/connector direction, not the V1 proof loop or Huey sovereignty.
explicit_non_claims: No live microphone is active in V1.
No wake word is active in V1.
No Huey Body actuation is active in V1.
No full HIMS/ThunderMail runtime governs V1.
No multi-agent constitutional governance is active in V1.
No distributed cognition or Farm compute is part of V1.

v1_plan.name: Huey Brain V1 — deterministic fixture-to-log proof
v1_plan.goal: Prove that one known MP3 fixture or fixture batch can run through media preparation, local transcription, response bridge, and structured logging on Huey Brain without hidden manual repair.

canonical_loop.name: fixture_selection
tools: fixture registry or manual CLI during bring-up

canonical_loop.name: media_probe_and_prepare
canonical_loop.output: mono 16 kHz transcription-ready WAV plus preparation manifest

canonical_loop.name: local_transcription
tools: faster-whisper or equivalent local transcription engine

success_conditions: Same fixture can be rerun and compared.
Prepared audio and manifest are deterministic enough for debugging.
Transcript and response are captured or failure is explicit.
Structured JSONL log is complete and attributable.
No live mic, wake word, Body actuation, governance runtime, or distributed compute is required.
implementation_priorities: Finish media manager, validator, speech pipeline, and fixture registry.
Keep response bridge mock/API/local modes explicit.
Make structured log schema stable before expanding UI.
Do not add HIMS control until the simple path is boringly repeatable.

v1_5_augmented_proof.name: Huey Brain V1.5 — augmented proof without scope explosion
v1_5_augmented_proof.purpose: Add visibility, traceability, and internal-message rehearsal around the same V1 fixture loop without activating live audio, body actuation, or full governance.
v1_5_augmented_proof.scope_statement: V1.5 augments the V1 proof with HIMS shadow messages, dashboard-visible status, PyHuey tool manifests, and media preview artifacts. It does not widen the input source or actuation boundary.
adds_to_v1: HIMS shadow message for each V1 pipeline stage.
HIMS event journal linking queued, delivered, read, archived, or stage-complete state.
Command Center seed/status export for V1 run health and fixture readiness.
PyHuey-safe tool manifest for media, V1 proof, and HIMS inspection commands.
operator-facing summary of run history without exposing secrets.
augmented_loop: Each stage emits a non-controlling HIMS trace message.
Structured V1 log remains canonical proof artifact.
HIMS trace provides replay and future routing rehearsal.
Command Center and PyHuey read/export safe status only.
v1_5_augmented_proof.completion_signal: A fixture batch produces normal V1 logs plus coherent HIMS shadow traces and dashboard/tool-manifest visibility, with no additional runtime authority granted to HIMS or GUI layers.
risk_controls: HIMS shadow trace must never be required for V1 success.
GUI layers must not execute arbitrary shell commands.
PyHuey must expose fixed safe tools only.
Command Center must stay read-only/copy-only unless explicitly promoted.

hims.name: Huey Internal Messaging System

current_implementation_posture.foundation_pr: PR #748 draft at time of v120 generation
current_implementation_posture.important_boundary: The HIMS package can exist before HIMS becomes a controlling runtime. V1 remains simple pipeline plus structured log.

hims.core_idea: HIMS is the internal message, route, validation, and record layer that lets Huey subsystems communicate without direct memory sharing or hidden authority collapse.
why_it_exists: To make requests, proposals, reports, alerts, refusals, and execution records visible and replayable.
To separate sender, router, validator, executor, and logger roles.
To prevent GUI, portal, LabTech, or agent layers from becoming hidden authorities.
To provide future lawful routing from input to decision to action without bypassing review.

thundermail_relation.ThunderMail: mail-style delivery semantics inside HIMS: inboxes, outboxes, acknowledgements, routing, and queues
thundermail_relation.HIMS: larger trust, validation, routing, compartmentalization, and preserved-record doctrine
thundermail_relation.rule: ThunderMail is delivery behavior; HIMS is the governing internal message system.

HIMSEvent.rule: State changes are separate append-only events.

HIMSStore.role: local JSONL store with send, inbox, outbox, channel, mark_delivered, mark_read, archive, events_for, status_for
HIMSStore.rule: No hidden mutation of previous records.

expansion_plan.name: V1.5 shadow trace
deliverables: non-controlling trace messages for fixture stages
cross-links between run logs and HIMS messages

trust_classes_v120.2_operator_visible: Messages intended for LabTech/Command Center visibility.
trust_classes_v120.3_private_or_role_restricted: Bounded agent, role, or office traffic not globally visible.
trust_classes_v120.4_official_record: Messages that become official project/runtime state records.
trust_classes_v120.5_safety_critical: Thermal, power, storage, motion, recovery, or preservation traffic.

v1_boundary: HIMS may be present as a library but not required for V1 completion.
V1 structured run log remains canonical proof artifact.
No citizen mailboxes, governance votes, or action authority in V1.
V1.5 may mirror stage traces to HIMS as shadow messages.
safety_rules: HIMS does not grant authority simply because a message exists.
GUI or LabTech-originated messages must remain bounded and auditable.
No physical action is triggered from HIMS without a separate future lawful execution path.
